Container.Name: ngPost-Deluxe
Container.Overview: ngPost Deluxe is a fast Usenet poster. This container watches a folder: every file or folder you drop in it is compressed (7-Zip, random name and password), protected with par2 (ParPar) and posted to your Usenet provider. The NZB file is written in the NZB folder and the history (with the archive passwords) in the config folder. The first time, fill in your Usenet server and the newsgroup(s): a configuration file is created in the config folder (you can then edit it, or put your own ngPost.conf there).

Config.Name: Watch folder
Config.Description: Everything you put in this folder is posted. It must be writable if you want the posted files to be deleted.

Config.Name: NZB folder
Config.Description: The NZB files are written here.

Config.Name: Config folder
Config.Description: ngPost.conf and the history of the posts (it contains the archive passwords in clear text: keep it private).

Config.Name: Work folder
Config.Description: Temporary folder for the archives and par2: it needs as much space as your biggest post (ideally on the cache or a fast disk).

Config.Name: Server host
Config.Description: Address of your Usenet server, for example news.example.com. Only used to create ngPost.conf the first time.

Config.Name: Server password
Config.Description: Your Usenet account password. It is visible in the container settings: if you prefer, put your own ngPost.conf in the config folder instead.

Config.Name: Connections
Config.Description: Number of connections to the server (check what your provider allows).

Config.Name: Newsgroups
Config.Description: Newsgroup(s) to post in, separated by a comma, for example alt.binaries.test

Config.Name: Archive volume size (MB)
Config.Description: Split the archive in volumes of this size. 0 = no split.

Config.Name: Delete after posting
Config.Description: Delete the files from the watch folder once they are posted.

Config.Name: Scan delay (s)
Config.Description: Seconds without size change before a new file is considered complete and posted.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the program runs as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the program runs as (100 = users).
